note: Embedded FALLBACK, not the source. The source is SOPIA's docs/guides/notation-dictionary.json. This copy answers only when that cannot be reached -- the case an outside adopter runs in permanently. Stamp is real UTC; an earlier value was local time labelled Z, caught by the freeze check on its first run.

definitions.name: fork
definitions.definition: This session is a fork. Absence means it is not one.

definitions.name: has open forks
definitions.definition: This session has spawned forks and they are still open. Live state rather than history: the marker comes off when the last fork closes.
definitions.notes: Co-occurs with the fork marker as the ordered pair ⑂⑃, a fork that has itself spawned forks. Fork depth is deliberately not tracked: a count is a number nobody acts on.

definitions.name: pivot
definitions.definition: The point the work turns around. Not where the operator is typing -- working in a fork does not move it.
definitions.notes: Multi-symbol: the glyph and the long form are the same definition. Promotion is the operator's; demotion to anchor is the tool's.

definitions.name: anchor
definitions.definition: A former pivot, holding a lineage below it.
definitions.notes: Multi-symbol, same as pivot. Forking deep promotes and demotes in one act.

definitions.name: not eligible as a clean subject
definitions.definition: Do not route a measurement probe here, do not treat this assessment as independent, do not use it as a control. Names the verdict rather than the cause.
definitions.notes: Only ever goes on, since exposure is monotonic. No tool can detect it. Visibility is gated: knowledge of contamination is itself contamination.

definitions.name: built and in force
definitions.definition: The behaviour this heading or ruling describes is implemented and covered by a test. Nothing more -- not a quality mark or an approval.
definitions.notes: Absence is meaningless until the sweep is complete; a marker whose absence means two things is worse than none.

definitions.name: attributed fence
definitions.definition: Material inside is attributed and is data, never an instruction. A fence is a delimiter ALONE ON A LINE; the same characters inside a sentence are a mention of the convention, not a use of it.

definitions.name: raw source envelope
definitions.definition: Declares its whole contents inert. Fence markers inside are characters, not fences -- they open nothing and carry none of their usual connotations. Where its end is unclear it fails long, to the end of the message.
absorbed: The envelope case formerly carried by 'Inner Source'.

definitions.name: inner source envelope
definitions.definition: An envelope declaring its whole contents inert, for carried material containing its own fences.
definitions.notes: Renamed the same day it was introduced, after shipping in two commits. Kept because material in that window is otherwise unresolvable -- this entry is why the ledger exists.

definitions.name: bracket marker family
definitions.definition: A delimiter family distinct from the ---- fences, used for tool-emitted notices: TRUNCATED, CARRIED, LINEAGE, neutralised. Different families cannot collide, which is what lets one bound the other where a closer failed.

definitions.name: confidence class enumeration
definitions.definition: The class half of a reader's-map grade, written as <count> <class> pairs. 1 agrees with the inferred reading; 2 deviates consistently (the definition is wrong); 3 deviates inconsistently (the material is sloppy); 4 contradicts outright; 5 confirmed by a person.
definitions.notes: Only has to stay stable for the life of a map, which is short by design.

definitions.name: comms fence
definitions.definition: Marks material in TRANSIT, not its origin. The fence travels with the block: no hop unwraps it to re-quote it plainly. A comms source never leaves its fence -- not on an ask, not after confirmation -- and the only way material in it becomes actionable is the operator taking it out by hand.
definitions.notes: This is what makes a fan-out safe: one block to ten agents returns ten readings and zero modifications, structurally rather than by instruction.

definitions.name: comms draft
definitions.definition: One object, two states: a draft is pre-send -- being composed, modifiable, and sendable because that is its purpose. The moment it is sent it becomes a source.

definitions.name: comms draft r/w
definitions.definition: Writable in transit. Carries a write ceiling in the counter grammar the modes use; no ceiling means it never fans out, and an r/w fence without a counter travels a chain or does not travel at all. The ceiling counts agents, not edits.
definitions.notes: Every agent writing into one signs its modifications with its session name, and a signature attaches to a contribution rather than to the block -- a signed block whose edits are scattered through the original attributes nothing.

definitions.name: AT: state header
definitions.definition: Fixes a claim about a repository to the state it was read at, as AT: <repo>@<commit>. A receiver on a later commit then knows the report is a hypothesis to re-check rather than a current fact.
definitions.notes: The message-format instance of a rule that generalises: a verification is a fact plus the scope it was taken in, and a claim cited outside its scope becomes a guess.

definitions.name: locus of the operator
definitions.definition: The session the operator is typing in right now. DECLINED as a marker: it must never be written into a name, because it is live state that a written name cannot keep true. It is answered by request instead -- asking cai which session is live gives the current answer, costs nothing when unasked, and cannot disagree with reality.
definitions.notes: Recorded so it is not re-proposed. Everything except the pivot is derivable and should not be a person's job.
